- The local strain exponent falls from about 1.2 at T ≈ 2.2 to about 0.45 at T ≈ 5.6, so the exponent depends on T.

Pure products of power laws, exponentials, and T-dependent exponents (NMSE 0.04–0.06) did not fit. Additive offset-plus-hardening forms did much better, but none reached the target.

def equation(eps, T, params):
